Around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]], led by [[Col Serra]], [[Mission to Naboo (Renegade Squadron)|raided]] an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''weapons depot''' on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The depot was guarded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sarkli]] and his [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]], who retreated after coming under fire from the Renegades. The depot contained dozens of crates containing weapons and ammunition, which the Renegades looted. The only office in the building contained a [[safe]] where [[Datafile/Legends|datafiles]] were stored concerning the [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]]-equipped [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Conqueror (superlaser)|''Conqueror'']].
